entities.name: Károly Levitzky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Károly Levitzky was a Hungarian rower who competed at the 1908 Summer Olympics in London and at the 1912 Summer Olympics in Stockholm. He won a bronze medal in single sculls in London.
